pins.derivation: Unmodified Lighthouse exporter traces, synthetic timestamp origin 1e9 microseconds. Omit exporter trailing one-ms artificial Task, exclude Low/VeryLow image network endpoints only as Lighthouse LCP does, take maximum remaining network/CPU end for each branch. Branch mean agrees with every budget LCP within 0.001ms. Schedules retain low images so contention remains visible. This does not compute counterfactual savings.
